name: lumora
description: Turn screen recordings, screenshots or a website into cinematic product demo videos.

interface.longDescription: Lumora turns a screen recording, a screenshot or a public website into a short product demo video: a 3D camera move over your interface, callouts that point at features, captions, a device frame, a title card, music and a call to action. Ask for a launch video, a changelog clip or a vertical social video of the app you are building. Preview frames before exporting, then get an MP4, GIF or WebM with a share link. Lumora edits your own footage with motion graphics; it does not generate imagery with an AI model. A free Lumora account includes three exports a month.
defaultPrompt: Make a 12 second launch video of https://example.com with Lumora
Turn demo.mp4 into a vertical Reels video with captions
Screenshot the dashboard and make a Lumora trailer in our brand colours
